Lite version: HTML-only, English-only, no analytics/PPTX/MD/CDN.

ClawVision Lite 1.0.0 — initial release.

- Provides visual, exportable summaries of OpenClaw chat sessions as HTML infographics, PNGs, Markdown, and PowerPoint files.
- Introduces a Summary Design Specification step and five aesthetic presets.
- Only runs on explicit user request; enforces clear permission and security guidelines before summarizing session content.
- Supports analytics charts embedded in exports, language switching (EN/RU/ZH), and light/dark themes.
- Allows user to customize language, layout, format, and style before generating exports.
